decisions.reason: 'Đang tổng kết' is a natural in-progress tally status and is already compact enough for a short system label.
The proper stage wording is preserved while the redundant 'Phần' is removed from this reward-category header, reducing width without introducing new stage terminology.
This compact form naturally means 'my rank' and removes the wider nominal construction without losing the personal-ranking meaning.
In an empty ranking panel, 'để hiển thị' is redundant screen context; the shorter message preserves the absence of ranking data.
Dropping 'Phần' keeps the reward-for-reaching-Special-Score meaning while making the category visibly narrower.
'Đã hết hạn' is natural, precise, and already compact for an expired-status label.
For a Home navigation tile, the list context is implicit; the canonical compact Support Card label is sufficient and much narrower.
Because this control is on the Home screen, repeating 'Trang chủ' is redundant; the compact settings label remains unambiguous.
The source specifically means raising Awakening Lv; 'Tăng Lv' is more direct and compact than the wide 'Cường hóa Lv' construction.
This concise action preserves the level-enhancement meaning and is much better suited to a fixed Home control.
The shorter form keeps the cap-unlock meaning while removing an unnecessary verb component from a constrained menu label.
This matches the canonical UI short form and fixes inconsistent capitalization without expanding the already compact label.
编组强化 may name a combined formation/enhancement destination rather than a simple strengthening action; shortening it safely requires neighboring Home-tile context.
'Cốt truyện' is natural Vietnamese and only marginally wider than the heuristic target; shortening it would be stylistic rather than a meaningful UI fix.
'Đang chuẩn bị' correctly preserves the in-progress status and is compact enough; removing 'Đang' would change the state nuance.
The shorter action remains clear that the linked external page will be opened and fits a button better than the current phrasing.
